front_active: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final tileable-face texture for a Minecraft 1.19.2 scientific instrument block, original Subspace Engineering pixel art. Output is a SINGLE flat square texture filling the ENTIRE image edge-to-edge, strictly front-on orthographic with NO perspective, no bevelled cube render, no surrounding margin, no lettering or numbers. Work on exactly a logical 32x32 pixel grid; magnify that grid uniformly using nearest-neighbor if a large canvas is needed. All pixels opaque. Crisp broad flat pixel clusters, no antialiasing, blur, noise, smooth gradients, bloom, or photographic shading. Upper-left highlights. Palette near-black #101319 #1B2028, gunmetal #2C3440 #465263 #657184, copper #74432B #B8753E and brass #D6AA59 #FFE19B, cyan #087F98 #20CEDB #A4F8FF, violet #351347 #471078 #6425B7 #AE3FFF #F33CCF and tiny crystalline #EACDFF #FFF0FF. Dark material dominates. Physical depth will be added separately using Minecraft JSON geometry. Front ACTIVE face of a Subspace Detector. Precise layout on 32x32 logical pixels: near-black border at x0..1 and x30..31; stout vertical copper/brass structural rails x2..5 and x26..29; dark inset gunmetal scientific panel inside. A small centered vertically elongated luminous violet crystalline sensor occupies x12..19,y10..21, faceted violet/magenta diamond with tiny white upper-left glint, inside a copper socket x10..21,y8..23. A small cyan oscilloscope display rectangle occupies x6..9,y12..19 and a second x22..25,y12..19, each with a distinct cyan broken waveform on near-black. Bottom status display x10..21,y25..27 with three cyan illuminated segments. Top plate x7..24,y3..6 has two silver screws. Four copper corners with one-pixel brass highlights, compact dark seams. Absolutely NO lettering or digits. Readable as a dark scientific instrument with a small central crystal and two flanking screens.
